records.document_text: 东川站蒋家沟泥石流视频数据说明东川站自2020年在蒋家沟泥石流沟道一侧安装了高分辨率摄像机（3840 × 2160 / 25 fps），可捕捉到泥石流运动的实时画面。2023年泥石流运动视频由安装在鸡冠山（103.135°，26.249°）的摄像机所拍摄。摄像机安装地点紧邻泥石流运动要素观测断面。鸡冠山视频监测摄像机备注：（1）请在论文发表、专利申请、专著出版等工作中标注数据来源，并在公开发表的中文出版物的致谢部分标明“感谢中国科学院东川泥石流观测研究站为本研究提供了相关数据”，在英文论文致谢部分标明“Dongchuan Debris Flow Observation and Research Station (DDFORS), Chinese Academy of Sciences, which provided the field observation data for this study.”.（2）更多详细信息见东川站网页（中文网站http://nsl.imde.ac.cn/；英文网站http://nsl.imde.ac.cn/en/）.（3）数据问题可联系魏丽（weili@imde.ac.cn）和宋东日（drsong@imde.ac.cn）.Debris flow video at Jiangjia RavineSince 2020, high-resolution cameras (3840 × 2160 at 25 fps) have been installed on one side of the debris flow channel, including the observation section. These cameras capture real-time footage of debris flow movements, which can be used for velocity analysis, flow state assessment, and other related tasks.The provided debris flow video was captured by the camera installed at Jiguanshan (103.135°, 26.249°) , the location is close to the observation section of debris flow kinematic characteristics.Cameras installed at JiguanshanNote:(1) In works such as paper, patent, and monograph, please indicate the data source. In the acknowledgments section of Chinese publications, include the statement “感谢中国科学院东川泥石流观测研究站为本研究提供了相关数据” . In the acknowledgments section of English publications, please state, “We would like to thank the Dongchuan Debris Flow Observation and Research Station (DDFORS), Chinese Academy of Sciences, for providing the field observation data for this study.”(2) For more detailed information, please visit the website of Dongchuan Debris Flow Observation and Research Station (DDFORS) (Chinese website: http://nsl.imde.ac.cn/; English website: http://nsl.imde.ac.cn/en/).(3) For any data-related issues, please contact Li Wei (weili@imde.ac.cn) and Dongri Song (drsong@imde.ac.cn).

records.document_text: 2026年8月18日21时45分，云南东川泥石流国家野外科学观测研究站所观测的蒋家沟暴发泥石流（22:06到达观测断面，塔吊断面）。文件提供的视频是塔吊、鸡冠山、门前沟汇口三个位置在泥石流爆发前的常规水流及洪水视频（19点之后视频不清楚，故未提供），希望对你有用。
经过再次确认，2026年8月18日，上游14:24发生泥石流，本次文件中的视频为常规水流的视频。上次给你发送的百度网盘的文件由于上游发生了泥石流，因此到达塔吊断面的不能视为常规水流，属于小型泥石流的状态。

source3_source4_relationship.source3_earlier_statement: Before main event at21:45; ordinary water/flood supplied.
source3_source4_relationship.source4_later_correction: Reconfirmed upstream14:24; previous delivery at tower crane is small debris flow; current delivery ordinary water.
source3_source4_relationship.decision: Read both together. Do not use source3 earlier statement alone to relabel v4 all N. Delivery context is not a per-second label.
source3_source4_relationship.precedence_evidence: source4 text explicitly states reconfirmation and previous delivery, not file mtime.
